title: skeleton template variables
description: Values for templates/skeleton.md.j2 and templates/skeleton.html.j2. Field names match content/02-output-contract.xml; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

workload_name.title: Workload name
workload_name.description: Which workload does this pack cover, as named in the service catalogue?

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: Which workload tier sets its RPO/RTO? An unassigned workload takes the strictest tier.

business_owner.title: Business owner
business_owner.description: Who agreed the RPO and RTO for this tier, as role:handle?

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Which architect is accountable for the pack, as role:handle?

primary_region.title: Primary region
primary_region.description: Which cloud region is primary today (e.g. eu-west-1)?

secondary_region.title: Secondary region
secondary_region.description: Which region takes over on failover?

rpo_minutes.title: RPO minutes
rpo_minutes.description: How many minutes of data may be lost, as an integer agreed with the business owner?

rto_minutes.title: RTO minutes
rto_minutes.description: Within how many minutes must the workload be serving again, as an integer agreed with the business owner?

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: Which single pattern is chosen from RPO/RTO and cost?

achievable_rpo_minutes.title: Achievable RPO minutes
achievable_rpo_minutes.description: What RPO does the chosen pattern actually deliver, from the measured replication lag?

achievable_rto_minutes.title: Achievable RTO minutes
achievable_rto_minutes.description: What RTO does the chosen pattern actually deliver, from the last drill or the scale-up time?

dns_mechanism.title: DNS mechanism
dns_mechanism.description: How does traffic move to the secondary — DNS failover records, a global load balancer, anycast, or none?

db_engine.title: Database engine
db_engine.description: Which database engine and managed service replicates across regions?

replication.title: Replication
replication.description: Is database replication synchronous or asynchronous?

p99_lag_seconds.title: p99 lag seconds
p99_lag_seconds.description: What was the p99 replication lag in seconds over the last 30 days? For async replication RPO must be at least this.

mechanics_last_changed_at.title: Mechanics last changed at
mechanics_last_changed_at.description: When did replication, DNS or promotion mechanics last change, as YYYY-MM-DD? A drill older than this makes the pack unverified.

drill_report_url.title: Drill report URL
drill_report_url.description: What URL holds the last drill report with measured RTO and RPO?

review_cadence.title: Review cadence
review_cadence.description: How often is the pack reviewed — monthly or quarterly?
